components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary study action with clear visual priority.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #b7152b; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a01226; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7152b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that stays quiet beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d8; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #3f3f46; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7152b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Readable field for search and account forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Search lessons<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Course or vocabulary"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #3f3f46; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d8; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #171717; font: 400 16px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #b7152b; outline: 3px solid rgb(183 21 43 / .2); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Compact dashboard link with a quiet inactive state and clear selection.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: #71717a; text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fafafa; color: #18181b; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: #fef2f2; color: #b7152b; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7152b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Learning Card
components.description: A calm surface for the next lesson, review, or progress summary.

Continue learning

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A short text status that pairs a tinted surface with an explicit label.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fef2f2; color: #b7152b; font: 700 12px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'M PLUS 1p', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
KujiLingo’s web product is a clear place to study, review, and find the next useful lesson. Be Vietnam Pro anchors Vietnamese interface copy, while M PLUS 1p and Noto Sans support Japanese text and readable fallbacks. The visual language is familiar and compact: a white canvas, cool zinc neutrals, a restrained crimson accent, and recognizable controls.

The red thread marks primary actions, selected navigation, and meaningful progress. It should guide attention through a study task, not turn the interface into a scoreboard. Keep lesson content ahead of streaks and rewards; avoid pressure, gamification that distracts from learning, and clutter that hides the next action.
keyCharacteristics: A light, readable canvas with cool neutral structure.
Kuji Crimson reserved for actions, selection, links, and important progress.
Familiar controls with compact labels and clear interaction states.
Learning progress is visible without making missed days feel like failure.

rules.name: The Red Thread Rule
rules.body: Use crimson to point to an action or a meaningful state. Do not use it as decoration across large inactive surfaces.

rules.name: The Utility Type Rule
rules.body: Keep product UI in the established sans stack. Do not use display faces for labels, buttons, or data.

rules.name: The Surface-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with spacing, type, and borders first; use stronger shadows only when a layer must sit above another.

dos: Do use the established crimson for primary actions and selected states, with white and zinc neutrals around it.
Do make the next lesson or review action easy to find.
Do keep body text readable, preserve visible keyboard focus, support reduced motion, and pair color states with text or icons.
Do use borders and spacing before stronger shadows; keep state transitions short and purposeful.
Do let lesson content lead; use progress indicators to support learning.
donts: Don't make learners feel pressured or guilty about missed study days or streaks.
Don't let gamification compete with or distract from learning.
Don't add clutter that obscures the next useful learning action.
Don't use display fonts in product labels, buttons, or data.
Don't use crimson as decoration across large inactive surfaces or depend on color alone to convey state.
